v2.0:
Arduboy compatibility layer dropped for a native Flipper renderer and app shell, progress, coins, score and high score saved to the SD card, sound played through the system speaker and muted with stealth mode, input handling rewritten without the callback race

v1.2:
Controls remapped for the Flipper keypad: pause on Back with Down, vacuum on held Back, door entered with Up, title logo and a clean exit from the main menu

v1.1:
Full-screen redraw reworked for the Flipper canvas, sprite and collision fixes after the port

app release
